items.description:
Explore the nature and pick up all its beautiful flowers!
These teens love them!

+ 10 cute skins, spreading flowers and great vibes everywhere!
+ Embrace the nature with the help of these teens!
+ By Senior Studios!

items.title: Cyborg Teens
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Beep-Bop-Beep. You can do anything you want with these awesome Cyborg skins. Show everyone how cool you are by living in the future!

items.title: Fashion Fall

items.description:
Embrace the fall season and equip the freshest fashion!
Jackets, scarves or coats - they'll all make you trendy!

+ 10 teen skins, providing you with the ultimate fall collection!
+ Team up with your friends and enjoy the seasonal adventures together!
+ By Senior Studios!

items.title: Fall Animals
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Meet your favourite animals, now dressed in seasonal clothing!
Enjoy the fall and prepare for the holiday season in great style!

+ 10 cute, detailed skins, providing you with amazing seasonal vibes!
+ Reindeers, penguins or pandas - they're all dressed with the freshest fall clothing!
+ By Senior Studios!

items.title: Winter Pals HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Play as an adorable winter themed creature with detailed holiday sweaters and attire! Penguins, polar bears, reindeer, and more. Great for roleplays and other festive game play. 

+ 9 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Classic Skyblock
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Different biome islands have been added to the classic skyblock fun! Don't forget to check the treasures inside the hidden chests to expand your island.

- Includes skins.
- By Pixelusion & xfaddy

items.description:
Join the kpop madness! Choose any of these unique and cool skins and start having fun.

- 2 free skins!

Created by xfaddy & published by Kuboc Studios

items.title: TOP 10 V6

Looking for a fresh style? These skins will blow you away! Here is the sixth release of Top 10 for Minecraft! For all gamers.

10 HD (128px) skins including:


- 9 trending outfits
- 1 exclusive free skin by: Dannny0117

Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.title: Secret Mountain Base
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description: Explore and make your house this secret refuge literally inside of one amazing mountain, protect yourself from an apocalypse, or play with your friends!

items.title: Pro Gamer
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Do you want to be a gaming pro? Choose one of the skins to start your career.

+ 10 skins
+ 2 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Skyblock Pirate Story
items.creator: Everbloom Games
items.description:
Skyblock like you've never seen before! As a pirate, you must survive on a barren island in the sky and gather resources to restore the land. Take your flying ship from island to island and complete quests to upgrade your ship and prevent a crew of sky pirates from getting hold of the forbidden treasure.
- Skyblock with a story
- Complete quests
- Singleplayer recommended

items.title: Futuristic Mining
items.creator: Everbloom Games
items.description:
Aliens have come to earth far in the future to uncover the secrets of a long-forgotten species known as humans! Your task is to mine for and analyze fossilized objects for display in a museum.
- Dig up "ancient" artifacts.
- Mine ores to buy better mining equipment.
- Meet the lively townspeople.
- Hilariously wrong interpretations of everyday objects.
SUPPORTS MULTIPLAYER

items.title: Desert Refuge
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
Journey to faraway lands and seek shelter from the heat in this beautiful desert palace! 

- HUGE palace with ornate details
- Detailed interiors
- 30 houses for your friends
- Two HD skins
- Custom desert terrain

From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Underwater Base
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Welcome to the ultimate underwater base! Start your next survival adventure and expand the base as you want!

+Single and multiplayer friendly
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Pets Play
items.creator: Cyclone
items.description:
Cuter, friendlier and more active than ever! Pets Play has every feathered, fuzzy and fluffy friend you love and more!
Care for them, play with them and dress them for the job! Does your pet work on a farm or as a firefighter in the city?
+ 55 unique pet companions
+ 18 Accessories & 20+ items to interact
+ give your pet one of 14 jobs with special costumes

items.title: Underground Paradise
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Tired of working? Step into a world of paradise full of all your desires! Explore the area and find hidden treasures!

+ Beautiful fantasy map!
+ Peaceful and natural

- By Orbital Studios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Secret Treehouses Base

Are you ready? Now you can enjoy the Lucky Wars experience, play with your friends, practice your PVP, be the last alive!

by UnderBlocks

items.title: Cops vs Thieves
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Check out this awesome cops and robbers skin pack! It's perfect for your roleplay. You can be the most strategic police officer who arrests several famous thieves throughout your life, or the smartest prisoner that no prison holds you until today! With a variety of 10 totally different skins, you can have a lot of fun!

- Amazing skins!
- By Pixelusion & EcoStudios.

items.title: Village Skyblock
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
A brand new adventure awaits you in the world of Skyblock! Grow your village into a bustling town! Defend your land against monsters!

- Includes skins.
- By Pixelusion & xfaddy

items.title: Lucky Block Parkour
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Parkour! First, parkour to the end to reach the king's throne. Second, slap some lucky blocks! Test your luck! Lastly, survive as best as you can! These lucky blocks can be brutal! Good luck!

items.title: Anime Realm
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Binge-watching anime shows are the new hobby of all our teens! Get to know everyone and jump in your comfy clothes. Hop on the cozy couch and join everyone else who is watching the show tonight! Have a fun time together while eating popcorn. These quality moments are unforgettable!

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary
